name: Cape Coast
tagline: Slave castles and rainforest canopy walks
summary: Cape Coast is a fishing town on Ghana's coast, home to the slave-trade castles of Cape Coast and Elmina, now UNESCO sites and places of remembrance. Walk the dungeons and the Door of No Return, cross the canopy walkway of Kakum National Park and relax on the palm-lined beaches nearby.
seasonNote: November to March is drier; rains from April to July.
arrival: About 3 hours by road from Accra.
cashTip: Ghanaian cedi is the local money; carry cedis for taxis and markets. Prices here are shown in US dollars.
foodTip: Fried fish with banku or kenkey, red-red (beans and plantain) and jollof rice.
